name: murmur
description: Notes, kept close. Offline notes shared directly with nearby devices.

scripts.build: npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.android:release: node scripts/mobile.mjs android build --apk --target aarch64 --target armv7 && python3 scripts/android-signing.py sign && python3 scripts/check-android-scanner.py --apk out/Murmur-android-universal.apk
scripts.lint: eslint src native.ts tests vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts --max-warnings 0
